description: Source code for QpackOfflineDecoder class, used for testing QPACK offline interop data, including parsing input filenames, decoding header blocks from files, and verifying decoded headers against expected headers.

classes.name: QpackOfflineDecoder
classes.description: Class responsible for decoding and verifying QPACK offline test data, handling file parsing, header decoding, and comparison.

methods.name: DecodeAndVerifyOfflineData
methods.description: Main method to decode header blocks from a file and verify against expected headers.

methods.name: OnEncoderStreamError
methods.description: Handles encoder stream errors, logs error message, and sets error flag.

methods.name: ParseInputFilename
methods.description: Parses the input filename to extract parameters for the decoder, such as dynamic table capacity and blocked streams.

methods.name: DecodeHeaderBlocksFromFile
methods.description: Reads and decodes header blocks from a specified file.

methods.name: VerifyDecodedHeaderLists
methods.description: Compares decoded header lists with expected headers from a file.

methods.name: ReadNextExpectedHeaderList
methods.description: Reads the next expected header list from the expected headers data.

methods.name: CompareHeaderBlocks
methods.description: Compares two header blocks for equality, accounting for header reshuffling.
